codeReview.summary: The feature ships the modal, orb animations, close button, Android back handling, theming, and locale additions, but the current implementation still misses key required behavior around scrollability, haptics, and thread persistence.

issues.description: The swipe-to-dismiss PanResponder claims any downward vertical drag on the full-screen container, and those pan handlers are attached to the root modal view. Once the voice thread has enough content, downward drags inside the thread will be treated as modal-dismiss gestures instead of scroll gestures, so the conversation thread is not reliably scrollable as required by VAL-VM-019.

Orb taps call triggerHapticMedium(), but that helper is hard-gated behind isIOS. Android therefore never receives the required expo-haptics feedback, which fails the cross-platform haptic requirement in VAL-VM-024.

openVoiceMode() clears voiceMessages every time the modal is opened, so reopening voice mode inside the same conversation drops the existing voice thread instead of persisting it with the active conversation as required by the feature description.
VoiceThread hardcodes English accessibility labels ('You said' / 'AI said') instead of using the existing i18n keys, so the feature's voice-mode labels are not fully localized in hi/mr.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The shared architecture note for the assistant is stale for voice mode ownership. It still says use-assistant orchestrates chat plus voice state, but the live code routes voice mode through a dedicated use-voice-mode hook from ChatScreen.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/library/architecture.md:40-41 documents use-assistant as the voice-state hook, while src/components/assistant/ChatScreen.tsx:48-49 imports useVoiceMode and src/hooks/use-voice-mode.ts now owns the voice-mode flow.

summary: Fail: the reviewed implementation covers the basic modal/orb shell, but the current code still blocks required behavior for a scrollable voice thread, Android haptics, and conversation-thread persistence.
